q: When Elijah told Elisha to stay behind, what did Elisha answer?
quote: As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live, I will not leave you.

q: How did Elijah part the waters of the Jordan?
why: The two crossed on dry ground.
quote: And Elijah took his cloak, rolled it up, and struck the waters

q: Before Elijah was taken away, what did Elisha ask to inherit?
a: A double portion of his spirit
why: Elijah said it was a hard request.
quote: Please, let me inherit a double portion of your spirit

q: What appeared and separated Elijah from Elisha?
quote: suddenly a chariot of fire with horses of fire appeared and separated the two of them

q: How did Elijah go up into heaven?
quote: and Elijah went up into heaven in a whirlwind.

q: After Elijah went up to heaven, what did Elisha pick up?
quote: Elisha also picked up the cloak that had fallen from Elijah

q: When Elisha struck the Jordan with Elijah's cloak, what happened?
quote: And when he had struck the waters, they parted to the right and to the left, and Elisha crossed over.

q: What did the woman of Shunem persuade Elisha to do when he passed by?
why: She was kind to the prophet.
quote: a prominent woman who lived there persuaded him to have a meal.

q: What did the Shunammite woman and her husband make for Elisha?
why: It had a bed, table, chair, and lamp.
quote: Please let us make a small room upstairs and put in it a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp for him.

q: What was the name of Elisha's servant at the Shunammite woman's house?
why: He called the woman for Elisha.
quote: And he said to Gehazi his servant, “Call the Shunammite woman.”

q: What did the kind Shunammite woman not have?
quote: Well, she has no son

q: What did Elisha promise the Shunammite woman?
quote: At this time next year, you will hold a son in your arms.

q: When Elisha prayed over the Shunammite's son, what did the boy do?
quote: and the boy sneezed seven times and opened his eyes.

q: After the boy came back to life, what did Elisha tell the Shunammite woman?
quote: Pick up your son.

q: Who was Naaman?
why: He was great, but had leprosy.
quote: Now Naaman, the commander of the army of the king of Aram, was a great man

q: What disease did the army commander Naaman have?
quote: And he was a mighty man of valor, but he was a leper.

q: Who told Naaman's wife about the prophet who could heal him?
quote: If only my master would go to the prophet who is in Samaria, he would cure him of his leprosy.

q: How many times did Elisha tell Naaman to wash in the Jordan?
quote: Go and wash yourself seven times in the Jordan

q: How did Naaman first react to Elisha's message to wash in the Jordan?
quote: But Naaman went away angry

q: After dipping in the Jordan, what was Naaman's skin like?
quote: and his flesh was restored and became like that of a little child, and he was clean.

q: When healed Naaman offered Elisha a gift, what did Elisha do?
quote: I will not accept it.

q: How old was Josiah when he became king of Judah?
quote: Josiah was eight years old when he became king

q: How did young King Josiah live?
quote: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD

q: In King Josiah's time, what did the high priest find in the temple?
quote: I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the LORD!

q: When King Josiah heard the Book of the Law read, what did he do?
why: He was grieved by Judah's sin.
quote: When the king heard the words of the Book of the Law, he tore his clothes

q: What did King Josiah read to all the people in the temple?
why: Everyone, small and great, heard it.
quote: and in their hearing he read all the words of the Book of the Covenant

q: What did King Josiah make before the LORD after reading the law?
quote: So the king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the LORD

q: How did King Josiah turn to the LORD?
quote: who turned to the LORD with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his strength

q: As Elijah went up, what did Elisha cry out?
why: He called him the chariots of Israel.
quote: My father, my father, the chariots and horsemen of Israel!

q: What sign did Elijah give that Elisha would receive a double portion?
quote: if you see me as I am taken from you, it will be yours.

q: When a poor widow asked Elisha for help, what did she have in her house?
quote: Your servant has nothing in the house but a jar of oil.

q: In the miracle of the widow's oil, when did the oil stop flowing?
a: When there were no more jars
why: She sold it to pay her debt.
quote: But he replied, “There are no more jars.” Then the oil stopped flowing.

q: Which rivers did Naaman think were better than Israel's waters?
quote: Are not the Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel?

q: Who persuaded angry Naaman to wash in the Jordan?
why: They called it a simple command.
quote: Naaman’s servants, however, approached him

q: What happened to Gehazi after he chased Naaman for a gift?
quote: And as Gehazi left his presence, he was leprous—as white as snow.

q: When a borrowed axe head fell into the water, what did Elisha make it do?
why: He threw a stick in the water.
quote: the man of God cut a stick, threw it there, and made the iron float.

q: When God opened his servant's eyes, what did he see around Elisha?
quote: he saw that the hills were full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.

q: Surrounded by enemies, what did Elisha tell his frightened servant?
quote: for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.

q: How old was Joash when he became king?
why: He was one of Judah's youngest kings.
quote: Joash was seven years old when he became king.

q: Which empire captured Samaria and carried Israel away?
why: It was in Hoshea's ninth year.
quote: the king of Assyria captured Samaria and carried away the Israelites to Assyria

q: Which king of Judah trusted the LORD so that no king was like him?
quote: Hezekiah trusted in the LORD, the God of Israel.

q: How many years did God add to King Hezekiah's life?
why: God heard his prayer and saw his tears.
quote: I will add fifteen years to your life.

q: As a sign for Hezekiah, what went back ten steps?
why: It was on the stairway of Ahaz.
quote: and He brought the shadow back the ten steps it had descended on the stairway of Ahaz.

q: When Babylon took Jerusalem, what happened to the house of the LORD?
why: The walls were broken down too.
quote: He burned down the house of the LORD, the royal palace, and all the houses of Jerusalem

q: From which town were Elijah and Elisha traveling just before Elijah was taken up?
why: They went on to Bethel and Jericho.
quote: Elijah and Elisha were on their way from Gilgal

q: How many sons of the prophets watched from a distance at the Jordan?
why: They saw Elijah part the water.
quote: Then a company of fifty of the sons of the prophets went and stood at a distance

q: On the road to Bethel, what did a group of boys jeer at Elisha?
quote: Go up, you baldhead! Go up, you baldhead!

q: How many sets of clothing did Naaman take to Israel?
why: He also took silver and gold.
quote: taking with him ten talents of silver, six thousand shekels of gold, and ten sets of clothing.

q: What was the name of the bronze snake King Hezekiah destroyed?
quote: He also demolished the bronze snake called Nehushtan that Moses had made

q: How many years did Hezekiah reign in Jerusalem?
quote: and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years.

q: How many Assyrians did the angel of the LORD strike in one night?
quote: and struck down 185,000 men in the camp of the Assyrians.

q: What did Isaiah have placed on King Hezekiah's boil?
quote: Prepare a poultice of figs.

q: Which high priest found the Book of the Law in King Josiah's day?
why: He gave it to Shaphan the scribe.
quote: Then Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe

q: Which scribe read the newly found Book of the Law to King Josiah?
quote: And Shaphan read it in the presence of the king.

q: Who was the Babylonian captain of the guard who burned Jerusalem?
why: He served the king of Babylon.
quote: Nebuzaradan captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, entered Jerusalem.
